headline: Share Market: 5 lakh crore rupees go up in smoke in minutes! Nifty at 23,350, Sensex down 340 points - Share Market 5 Lakh Crore Wiped Out in Minutes, Nifty Falls to 23350, Sensex Drops 340 Points
summary: Indian benchmark indices fell in intraday trade, with Nifty at 23,350 and Sensex down 340 points. Hindalco, Tata Steel, JSW Steel, InterGlobe Aviation and Bajaj Finance were among the biggest decliners on the Nifty.
why: The Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex are the main benchmark indices of the National Stock Exchange of India and BSE, tracking large listed Indian companies.
why_moved: The input reports a sharp, rapid sell-off that wiped out about 5 lakh crore rupees in market value, with the biggest declines in metals, steel, airlines and lending stocks. It does not state a cause.
